1.2.4 Update Notes


🍺 Tavern Route Update
The Tavern Route has been newly added.

In this route, where the Black Duck heads to the tavern, you will encounter new characters, face thrilling boss battles, and reach multiple branching endings.
This route begins when you choose the Hunter in the prologue, and it includes all related stories and endings.
🐣 Improvements
Improved certain dialogues that could not be skipped.

Enhanced the stage selection layout.

Improved visibility on the album screen.

Unlocking the album now grants you a commemorative artwork for the demo.

Collecting all artworks will grant you an additional “All Clear” commemorative artwork.

– Sunflo Labs & Solutena Studio

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 - Temple Route Update
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290117/a3286f7db256cb8a29d53f843a09a8add79f22bc.png"]

The following changes have been implemented in the 1.1.0v update.


🏰 Temple Route Update
The Temple Route has been newly added.

In the Temple Route, where the Black Duckling heads to the temple, players will encounter new characters, face intense boss battles, and experience multiple branching endings.

This route begins when the Shrine Maiden of the Sun is chosen during the prologue and includes all related storylines and endings.


🐣 Improvements
Adjusted the collision range of the well to match the size of both the duck and the human.

Changed idle NPCs (when AI stops) to leave the scene after a certain time.

Increased the player's invincibility time during jumps.

Changed healing NPCs so that they only target combat units (excluding other healing NPCs).

Increased the healing action delay of healing NPCs.

Improved the "Continue" feature so that you can resume from the boss battle of each route.

Made boss HP visible through the Mana UI.

Interaction targets are now refreshed immediately after transformation.


🔧 Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where NPC interactions did not function correctly in the credits.

Fixed an issue where some Game Over events would get stuck.

Fixed an issue where nighttime effects would not play.

Fixed an issue where events would proceed with NPCs still in a fleeing state.

Fixed an issue where, if an NPC’s dialogue was interrupted, the remaining NPCs would not return properly.

Fixed a rare issue where rolling could be used consecutively without cooldown.

Fixed a rare issue where the roll animation would start from the middle.

Fixed a camera stutter issue when exiting the Princess’s room.



– Sunflo Labs & Solutena Studio

notes.title: Update Notes – Version 1.0.11v
notes.notes:
The following fixes and improvements have been applied in the 1.0.11v update:



🐣 Key Input Issue Fixed
Fixed an issue where key inputs were still being registered in specific situations where they should have been disabled.



🐣 Castle Route Ending Issue Fixed
Fixed an issue where the ending would not trigger under certain conditions when progressing through the Castle Route from Stage 1.



🐣 Castle Route Boss Event Issue Fixed
Fixed an issue where delayed events could occur during the boss battle in the Castle Route.



🐣 Font Rendering Issue Fixed
Fixed an issue where thin lines would appear on certain characters due to font rendering problems.



🐣 Mana Calculation Issue in Stage 4 of Castle Route Fixed
Fixed an issue where the amount of mana obtained was not properly calculated for the ending condition in Stage 4 of the Castle Route.



🐣 Event Order Adjustments in Castle Route
Adjusted the order of events in some stages of the Castle Route for better flow.



🐣 Game Over Cancellation Issue Fixed
Fixed an issue where the game over process could be canceled in certain special conditions.



– Sunflo Labs & Solutena Studio

notes.title: Update Notes – Version 1.0.10v
notes.notes:
The following fixes and improvements have been applied in the 1.0.10v update:



🐣 Fixed an issue with skipping certain dialogues
Resolved an issue where skipping did not work for some dialogue scenes.



🐣 Adjusted mana consumption in the Castle Route
The required amount of mana in the Castle Route has been generally reduced.



🐣 Fixed NPC exit bug in Stage 7 of the Castle Route
Fixed an issue where some NPCs did not exit properly in Stage 7 of the Castle Route.



🐣 Adjusted boss normal attack range in the Castle Route
The boss’s normal attack range has been adjusted to match its visual effects.



– Sunflo Labs & Solutena Studio

notes.title: Update Notes – Version 1.0.8v
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290117/200a59ff3184d13ab085e2ed6b31cb38bbeab145.png"]

The following changes have been applied in the 1.0.8v update:



🐣 Mac OS Support
The game is now supported on Mac OS.



🐣 Transformation Issue Fixed in Castle Route Stage 4
Fixed an issue where transformation was possible in Castle Route Stage 4.



🐣 Additional Dialogue in Castle Route Stage 6
Added new NPC dialogue to help guide players more clearly through the stage.



– Sunflo Labs & Solutena Studio

notes.title: Update Notes – Version 1.0.7v
notes.notes:
The following fixes and improvements have been applied in the 1.0.7v update:



🐣 Improved Control Guide
The control guide has been updated to be more intuitive and easier to understand.



🐣 Fixed NPC Interaction Issue
Fixed an issue where some NPCs would trigger interaction even when not colliding with the player.



🐣 Fixed Castle Route Stage 6 Event Issue
Resolved an issue where certain events in Stage 6 of the Castle Route did not function properly.



🐣 Adjusted Boss Pivot Position in Castle Route
Corrected the boss’s pivot position, which was previously set incorrectly.



🐣 Balanced Boss in Castle Route

Increased the hitbox size of the “Cleave” skill.

Added a warning effect to the “Earthshatter” skill and increased its activation delay.

The “Earthshatter” skill can now only be avoided by jumping.



– Sunflo Labs & Solutena Studio

notes.title: Update Notes – Version 1.0.6v
notes.notes:
The following fixes and improvements have been applied in the 1.0.6v update:



🐣 Castle Route Stage 4 Dialogue Issue Fixed

Fixed an issue where the dialogue would replay after being completed in Stage 4 of the Castle Route.



🐣 Field Balance Adjustment

NPCs in the ‘Black Flame’ state will now exit after their next action.



🐣 Castle Route Boss Balance Adjustment

Reduced the boss's normal attack damage to 1.

Increased the frequency of skill usage.

Fixed an issue where the ‘Slash’ skill would not activate under certain conditions.



🐣 Castle Route Collision Issue Fixed

Fixed an issue where the character could move outside the map boundaries.



– Sunflo Labs & Solutena Studio

notes.title: Update Notes – Version 1.0.5v
notes.notes:
The following updates have been made in version 1.0.5v



🐣 "Always Be Happy..." Ending Issue Fixed

Fixed an issue where the "Always Be Happy..." ending would not trigger correctly.



🐣 NPC Balance Adjustments

Adjusted the hit detection types of certain NPCs to improve combat balance.



🐣 NPC Death Count Handling Revised

Certain NPCs that are not meant to die will no longer be counted toward death tallies.


– Sunflo Labs & Solutena Studio

notes.title: Update Notes – Version 1.0.4v
notes.notes:
The following updates have been made in version 1.0.4v



🐣 Cursor Hidden During Gameplay
The mouse cursor is now hidden during gameplay to provide a cleaner and more immersive experience.



🐣 Character Name Fix in Palace Route Stage 4
Fixed an issue where a character’s name was incorrectly displayed in a dialogue during Stage 4 of the Castle Route.
The character’s name will now appear correctly.



– Sunflo Labs & Solutena Studio
